supporting_observations.claim: WS-KNGUYEN-01 made multiple TCP connections to the internal proxy at 10.52.20.30:8080 during the alert window. The supplied Zeek records show sessions at 13:33:22, 13:37:01, 13:38:43, 13:42:05, 13:46:39, 13:52:02, 13:56:39, 14:02:04, 14:06:43, and 14:08:38 UTC.

The supplied Zeek connection records identify the internal proxy as the destination, but do not identify the external destination or the process that initiated these sessions. The organization inventory identifies PROXY-COP-01 as an explicit web proxy on port 8080.

The observed proxy-session pattern is plausibly consistent with the approved RouteWise updater, which inventory says checks for updates about every five minutes, but the supplied records do not establish that RouteWise generated these sessions.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-coverage metadata reports a collection outage for WS-KNGUYEN-01 winsec and sysmon, and for the proxy sensor, from 13:30 to 14:15 UTC. This overlaps the alert window and prevents endpoint process attribution and inspection of proxy request details.

The supplied Zeek records show connections to the internal proxy, not the external destinations or whether those requests used HTTPS. No corresponding SSL details are included in the supplied records.
claims_not_established: Whether the proxy sessions reached update.routewise.com or another external destination.
Whether the sessions were generated by the approved RouteWise updater or by another process.
Whether the alerted connections were encrypted HTTPS sessions, or whether their content or destination was malicious.
Whether the activity was authorized or associated with the scheduled svc-routes password rotation.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve PROXY-COP-01 access and CONNECT logs for the alert window, including requested hostnames, URLs where available, status codes, and client attribution.
Recover endpoint process and network telemetry for WS-KNGUYEN-01 during 13:30–14:15 UTC; correlate initiating processes and command lines with the proxy sessions.
Correlate available Zeek SSL records and DNS records with the session times to establish external hostnames and TLS details.
Verify RouteWise installation, updater execution history, and update-check configuration on WS-KNGUYEN-01.
unrelated_findings: A Defender DetectionHistory artifact was created on WS-KNGUYEN-01 at 13:20:33 UTC, before the alert window. The supplied record does not provide its detection contents or establish a connection to the alerted proxy sessions; investigate separately if warranted (T105-00001).

DC-COP-01 attempted connections to WS-KNGUYEN-01 on ports 8080 and 445 at 13:31:34–13:31:37 UTC; the Zeek records show rejected connections. These are not the workstation's alerted outbound proxy sessions and should be assessed separately (T105-00066, T105-00067, T105-00068, T105-00069, T105-00070).

The domain controller issued Kerberos service tickets for FILE-COP-01$ to the WS-KNGUYEN-01$ machine account during the review window. The supplied records do not establish resulting file access or a relationship to the alerted proxy activity; assess separately (T105-00143, T105-00148, T105-00279, T105-00290, T105-00313, T105-00318, T105-00322).
